Title: FF_TR_001 — Orders: Refresh table button visible near Export
Section: Fulfillment Console > BSD-29582 > Table Header Refresh > Orders
Preconditions: PROD Fulfillment Console; user logged in; Orders tab active; grid loaded
Steps:
1. Log in to Fulfillment Console
2. Confirm Orders tab is active and table data is loaded
3. Locate the table toolbar above the grid (button-section with Export)
4. Observe the Refresh table button next to Export
Expected Result: Refresh table button with refresh icon and label 'Refresh table' is visible in the table toolbar next to the Export button

Title: FF_TR_002 — Orders: Click Refresh table calls filterOrder API
Section: Fulfillment Console > BSD-29582 > Table Header Refresh > Orders
Preconditions: PROD Fulfillment Console; Orders tab active; network tab or dev tools available
Steps:
1. Open Orders tab with data loaded
2. Open browser network / GraphQL monitor
3. Click the Refresh table button
4. Inspect network requests
Expected Result: filterOrder GraphQL/API request is triggered and completes successfully; Orders grid refreshes

Title: FF_TR_003 — Orders: Refresh table does not duplicate table rows
Section: Fulfillment Console > BSD-29582 > Table Header Refresh > Orders
Preconditions: PROD Fulfillment Console; Orders tab with multiple rows visible
Steps:
1. Note total results count and first-page row identifiers on Orders tab
2. Click Refresh table once and wait for grid to settle
3. Click Refresh table again (or trigger while live update may occur)
4. Compare total count and row identifiers
Expected Result: Total results count does not double; no duplicate Order ID rows appear in the grid
